description.value: Ai-Boiled is a Sichuan/Canadian fusion restaurant located inside Garden City Mall in Richmond, BC, built around a fully customizable build-your-own noodle soup concept. Diners choose from fresh noodles, vegetables, meats, and seafood, which are cooked to order in a signature broth; some recipes are adapted to be less spicy to suit a broader range of palates. The business also operates a second Richmond location at Aberdeen Square on No 3 Road.
